content.text: Missing bound invariant `0 <= i <= |a|`: without it, the invariant on line 10 can't be proven well-formed (k < i may exceed |a|), and after the loop `!(i < |a|)` doesn't give `i == |a|`.

input.command:
cat > diagnosis.json <<'EOF'
{"spec_element": "invariant",
 "proof_obligation": "bridge",
 "diagnosis": "The loop lacks the bound invariant 0 <= i <= |a|. Without the upper bound, after the loop Dafny only knows |result| == i and i >= |a|, so it cannot conclude |result| == |a| (postcondition fails). The same missing bound makes the quantified invariant ill-formed: for k < i, a[k] and b[k] may be out of range since i is not known to be <= |a| (== |b|). Adding invariant 0 <= i <= |a| fixes both."}
EOF
sed -i '9i\        invariant 0 <= i <= |a|' program.dfy && dafny verify program.dfy

content.text:
Dafny now verifies `program.dfy` with no errors (2 verified, 0 errors).

**What was wrong:** the loop had no invariant saying `0 <= i <= |a|`. That one gap caused all three errors:
- **The postcondition (line 3):** when the loop ends, Dafny only knew `|result| == i` and `i >= |a|`. It couldn't conclude `|result| == |a|`, because nothing said `i` stays at or below `|a|`.
- **The two "index out of range" errors (line 10):** the invariant `forall k :: 0 <= k < i ==> result[k] == a[k] ^ b[k]` reads `a[k]` and `b[k]`. Dafny couldn't confirm those indexes were valid, since it didn't know `i <= |a|` (and `|a| == |b|`).

**Fix:** I added `invariant 0 <= i <= |a|` as the first loop invariant (now line 9). I wrote `diagnosis.json` before making the edit; it classifies the problem as `invariant` / `bridge`, because the main failure was the step from the invariants plus the loop exit to the postcondition.
